column1: # gemdos-mc-fs22.tsv -- DUMPBIOS, Pexec and Fsfirst meet a media change
# (TASK/TOOL20): the cases of the probe tosdump/probes/pxprobe.c (TASK/FS22)
# as a case table, against EmuTOS 1a7484ab (docs/analysis/ORACLE.md).
# EmuTOS, read from the source (docs/api/gemdos/_state.md section 4a): once a
# logical write of sector 0 has armed forcechange, the next GEMDOS access to
# the drive meets it and osif logs the drive in again and restarts the call
# (bdos/bdosmain.c:449-487).  Pexec is such a call: its ixsfirst
# (bdos/proc.c:258) meets the change, the restarted xexec loads the program.
# ixsfirst takes no DTA (bdos/proc.c:258, bdos/fsdir.c:452-477): the caller's
# DTA stays as it was.
# The child: x:C:\PXPROBE -- the run's profile adds the extension of the
# machine's programs (PROGEXT.TXT: the oracle PRG, NewTOS NAP), so each side
# starts its own build of tosdump/probes/pxprobe.c, and both builds lie on
# the test image; with the command tail "child" it returns 42 and does
# nothing else.  The DTA is buffer 1 (Fsetdta), read through the layout of
# docs/api/structures/dta.md (d:dta); its 21 reserved bytes are each
# system's own and not captured.  The DTA buffer is poisoned only by Fsetdta
# and Fsfirst, so the cases after a search see what it left there.
# WHERE IT RUNS, DESTRUCTIVE, the test image: as gemdos-mc-fs20.tsv.  The
# boot sector is written back unchanged, so the test partition must come out
# as it went in, on both sides.
# One table per round: a case id is the physical line number and the dump
# header carries the CRC of this file, so it is frozen once measured.
!layout
!disk
# ---- part P: Pexec meets the change

column5: P01 Fsfirst(C:\PXPROBE.*, 0): the DTA before the Pexec -- bdos/fsdir.c:523
P02 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
P03 write it back unchanged, RW_NOMEDIACH: arms -- bios/blkdev.c:450-453, 473-477
P05 Pexec(0, C:\PXPROBE.<own>, "child"): 42; the caller's DTA after it -- bdos/proc.c:179, 258
P06 Mediach(2): 0, the restart's Getbpb cleared it -- bios/blkdev.c:589-590
P07 Fgetdta(): the DTA behind the pointer it returns, unchanged -- bdos/fsmain.c:394

column1: # ---- part F: Fsfirst meets the change

column5: F01 sector 0 of C: into buffer 0 (RW_NOMEDIACH)
F02 write it back unchanged, RW_NOMEDIACH: arms
F04 Fsfirst(C:\PXPROBE.*, 0) after the restart -- bdos/bdosmain.c:449-487, bdos/fsdir.c:523
F06 Fsnext: the search the restarted Fsfirst set up -- bdos/fsdir.c:654
